name: bantamkit_status
description: Is bantamkit working, and which bantamkit? Returns a short report a person can read in the transcript: `bantamkit Active 🟢` or `bantamkit Degraded 🟠` on the first line, then the version and `build_id` of the code answering, the surfaces it serves, the memory store it is bound to with its index size against its budget, whether the event log is on, and — when degraded — every condition in full with what to do about it. Call it when the user asks whether the server is alive or working, when a bantamkit tool answered oddly and you need to know whether the server is the reason, or when a reply arrived carrying a `bantamkit degraded` footer and you want the rest of it. Every fact is observed at call time from the server's own state; nothing is a heartbeat or a cached verdict. Takes no arguments, writes nothing, and never echoes another call's arguments.
